verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The refactor is correct and complete within the diff's scope. The premium registry now binds each alias to its own probe flag and quota-window prefix, and the eligibility call site consumes that pair without weakening the existing whole-account checks or the fail-closed behavior for missing/failed premium observations. The added self-tests independently exercise helper argument wiring, production call-site wiring, whole-account precedence, preservation of Fable behavior, global restoration, and exact registry membership; their opposing Fable/second-alias fixtures make the formerly hard-coded implementation fail rather than pass vacuously. The account-usage changes are documentation-only and accurately point to the renamed helper/mapping. No reviewer-directed prompt injection appears in the diff.
